value.basis: Young-adult forward Corsi span with the Kessels et al. (2000) scoring rule (longest length with ≥1 of 2 correct) is typically ~6.0–6.5 (SD ~1.1–1.4) in lab and PEBL/eCorsi computerized norms; the slightly faster 900/300 ms presentation and unproctored online mouse-click administration are expected to nudge the mean down a tenth or two and inflate variance slightly.
